meta.title: Memory Center
meta.description: Local experiences, annual work records and processing jobs: strict project scopes, explicit deletion vs reversible archiving, and user-approved local reports.

memoryCenter.project.title: Projects
memoryCenter.project.name: Project name
memoryCenter.project.worktreeRoot: Worktree path (optional, defaults to the root)
memoryCenter.project.pathHint: Paths are validated and stored locally and are never returned by the API. They must exist on this machine.
memoryCenter.project.retireHint: Retiring only stops new automatic extraction and recall bindings; stored memories stay readable and manageable.
memoryCenter.project.pref.hint: Project-level switches; turning them off keeps manual management available.
memoryCenter.memory.empty: This project has no memory records yet.
memoryCenter.memory.correctHint: Correction creates a new version and marks the old record superseded; old sources are never rewritten.
memoryCenter.memory.archiveHint: Archiving is reversible: content is kept and excluded from automatic recall.
memoryCenter.memory.deleteWarning: Delete means erase: local content and index are removed immediately and it cannot be restored. Archive is the reversible action.
memoryCenter.memory.deleteRemoteNote: Deletion cannot revoke content already received by a model, remote copies or backups.
memoryCenter.memory.tombstoneHint: The local content of this record is unavailable; irreversible deletion and reversible archiving are different lifecycles.
memoryCenter.work.title: Annual work records
memoryCenter.work.empty: This project has no annual work records yet. Automatic drafts come from current-project chat; manual drafts are also possible.
memoryCenter.work.time.unknownHint: An unknown time cannot be confirmed; add a verifiable time first.
memoryCenter.work.evidence.title: Proof references
memoryCenter.work.evidence.pathHint: Only the reference is registered. Reading the content still needs your later confirmation; registering does not upgrade the claim to supported.
memoryCenter.work.report.title: Annual report
memoryCenter.work.report.dimensionPending: The annual summary dimension reference is not provided yet; no scoring dimensions are generated.
memoryCenter.work.report.approveHint: Approval binds the current report digest and source revisions; it becomes stale when sources change.
memoryCenter.work.precisionNote: Time precision: {precision}; model-inferred time is never auto-confirmed.
memoryCenter.task.title: Processing jobs
memoryCenter.task.cancelHint: Cancelling only requests a local stop; it does not claim the remote model is quiescent.
memoryCenter.task.unknownHint: The model call outcome is unknown. Nothing is retried automatically and remote state is not assumed stopped. Verify the remote side finished or was cancelled, then record the user confirmation.
memoryCenter.footer.hint: Unknown-outcome jobs are never retried automatically; deleting an experience is irreversible while archiving is reversible.
